title: Changing Min and Max in the part dialog writes one history entry
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-MINMAX-01) is tracked at {Location-A} with Min 2, Max 6 and Sell Price $20.00.
custom_steps:
1. Open {Part-A}, change Min to 3 and Max to 8, and click Save.
  2. Open {Part-A} again, change only Sell Price to $21.00, and click Save.
  3. Open {Part-A}'s Part History.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Steps 1 and 2: Both saves succeed.
  • Step 3: One entry reads "Min/Max updated | Min: 2 → 3 | Max: 6 → 8 | Source: Edit Part". The Sell Price save added no second "Min/Max updated" entry.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S10-R22a, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas 13 Oct copy: no board shows a Min/Max entry. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S10-R22a: “Changing Min or Max writes "Min/Max updated | Min: {old} → {new} | Max: {old} → {new} | Source: {source}" to the part's Part History, where the source is "Edit Part" or "Import". No entry is written when neither value changed.”
